component.name: KTasks
component.summary: Task, priority matrix, Pomodoro, routine, and journal manager for KDE Plasma
Gerenciador de tarefas, matriz de prioridades, Pomodoro, rotina e diário para o KDE Plasma

description.p: KTasks is an offline-first productivity application for KDE Plasma. Manage tasks, Eisenhower priority quadrants, Pomodoro focus sessions, time-blocked routines, and encrypted Markdown journal notebooks locally or synchronized with Nextcloud.

KTasks é um aplicativo de produtividade offline-first para o KDE Plasma. Gerencie tarefas, quadrantes da Matriz de Eisenhower, sessões Pomodoro, rotina com blocos de horário e diário em Markdown criptografado localmente ou sincronizado com o Nextcloud.

ul.li: Summary Home screen with daily KPIs, 10-day Open-Meteo weather forecast, and read-only KOrganizer/Akonadi external agenda
Lists, nested subtasks, tags, priorities, recurrence, interactive notifications, and Dolphin-style multi-selection
Eisenhower Priority Matrix with Guided Triage, Pomodoro execution timer, and productivity insights
Two-way Nextcloud synchronization for Tasks (CalDAV), Routines (CalDAV events), and Journal Notebooks (Nextcloud Notes API)

screenshot.caption: Summary dashboard with daily KPIs, weather, priorities, routine, and journal
Eisenhower Priority Matrix with Guided Triage and Pomodoro tracking

description.p: Add an Android package for 32-bit phones (armeabi-v7a), such as the Samsung Galaxy A01, which could not install the arm64 package.

First Android version (arm64): the same tasks, routine, priority matrix, journal, insights and Nextcloud synchronization, with system notifications for reminders. PDFs are now written the same way on every platform; printing stays a desktop feature.

Fix the Windows build: the interface is translated again, reminders and other notifications show as tray notifications, the tray icon no longer disappears, a profile picture can be chosen and loads correctly, and secure connections no longer miss their OpenSSL library. Windows now keeps a ktasks.log next to the data. The view leaves a list that was deleted, and a new end-to-end test exercises every part of the window.

Use compact fixed dimensions with internal notes scrolling for the Routine Block modal, and add a portable Windows x86_64 release build with native Windows autostart, single-instance, Credential Manager, and Discord named-pipe IPC support.
Add dynamic resizing and an expanded wide-view toggle to the Routine Block dialog, and wrap its notes field in a bounded scrollable area.
Add recurrence frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly) and repeat interval selection for Routine & Day Planner templates with SQLite v10 migration and CalDAV RRULE sync support.

Simplify Add-ons settings UI, unfocus inputs when clicking outside, prefer IPv4 for fast Open-Meteo weather search with busy indicator, keep only the latest pre-migration backup snapshot, and clarify Daily Activity & Focus chart legend and per-bar values.

Add Settings tabs with a new Add-ons section for privacy-first Discord Rich Presence during focus sessions, automatic PC Do Not Disturb mode while focusing, live remaining free time in Routine & Day Planner, and v9 backfill for pre-existing routine templates.
Fix Routine month and week header navigation, add forward-only start dates for recurring routine templates, and prompt before discarding unsaved modal changes on Escape or outside click.
Fix PDF export stat pills spacing, routine block duration formatting, and HighResolution footer font scaling.
Add separate hours and minutes duration picker across task execution estimates, routine blocks, and quick scheduling dialogs.
Fix QML Avatar import using org.kde.kirigamiaddons.components for full compatibility with KDE Application Platform 6.10 Flatpak runtime.
Automated Arch Linux (.pkg.tar.zst) and universal Flatpak (.flatpak) release packaging targeting KDE Platform 6.10.

Initial community release featuring Summary dashboard, Nextcloud Tasks/Routine/Notes sync, Eisenhower Priority Matrix, Pomodoro & Focus Timer, Productivity Insights, and KOrganizer/Akonadi read-only agenda.
